But the opposition that matters here has as its members the individuality conscious of itself and the abstraction of the outwardness that has wholly become a thing – that inner being of spirit conceived as fixed spirit-less being, opposed to just such a being.

– But with this, observing reason seems in fact to have reached its peak, from which it must leave itself and tumble over; for only the wholly bad has in itself the immediate necessity of inverting itself.

– As it can be said of the Jewish people that, precisely because it stands immediately before the gate of salvation, it is and has been the most rejected; what it should be in and for itself, this self-essentiality, it is not for itself, but places it beyond itself; through this externalization it makes a higher determinate being possible for itself, if it could take its object back into itself again, than if it had remained within the immediacy of being, because spirit is the greater the greater the opposition out of which it returns into itself; but this opposition it makes for itself in the sublating of its immediate unity and in the externalization of its being-for-itself.
But if such a consciousness does not reflect itself, the middle in which it stands is the unhappy emptiness, since that which should fill it has become a fixed extreme.
Thus this last stage of observing reason is its worst, but for that very reason its inversion is necessary.
zh: 自我意识着的理性的粗野本能会不加审视地抛弃一门颅骨科学，——即抛弃理性的另一种观察的本能，这种本能已经成长为对认识的一种预感，并且以无精神的方式把握了认识，认为外在是内在的表达。
但思想越是糟糕，它的糟糕究竟在哪里，有时就越不引人注意，也就越难把它拆解开来。
因为那种被它当作本质的抽象越是纯粹、越是空洞，思想就被称为越糟糕。
但这里所关涉的对立，其两端是意识到自身的个体性和完全变成了物的外在性的抽象，——精神的那个内在存在被理解为固定的、无精神的存在，与正是这样一种存在相对立。
——但这样一来，观察的理性似乎确实已经达到了它的顶点，从那里它必须离开自己并翻倒过去；因为只有完全糟糕的东西才自身带有直接翻转自己的必然性。

——就像可以说犹太民族那样：正因为它直接站在得救之门前，它才是最被弃绝的，并且一直是最被弃绝的；它自在自为地应当是的那个东西，这种自身本质性，它并不为自己拥有，而是把它放到自己之外；通过这种外化，如果它能够把它的对象重新收回自身之内，它就为自己使一种更高的定在成为可能，这比它停留在存在的直接性之内时更高，因为精神从越大的对立中返回自身，它就越伟大；而它是在扬弃自己的直接统一、在外化自己的自为存在时，为自己造出这个对立的。
但只要这样一种意识不反思自身，它所处的那个中项就是不幸的空虚，因为本该填充它的那个东西已经变成了固定的极端。
所以观察的理性的这最后一个阶段是它最糟糕的阶段，但正因如此，它的翻转是必然的。

en: For the survey of the series of relations considered so far, which constitute the content and object of observation, shows that in its first mode, in the observation of the relations of inorganic nature, sensuous being already disappears for it; the moments of its relation present themselves as pure abstractions and as simple concepts, which were supposed to be firmly tied to the determinate being of things, but that is lost, so that the moment proves to be pure movement and the universal.

This free process, completed in itself, retains the significance of something objective, but appears only as a one; in the process of the inorganic, the one is the non-existing inner; but existing as one, it is the organic.

– The one stands as being-for-itself or negative essence over against the universal, withdraws from it and remains free for itself, so that the concept, realized only in the element of absolute singleness, does not find in organic existence its true expression of being there as universal, but remains an outer or, what is the same, an inner of organic nature.

– The organic process is free only in itself, but is not so for itself; in the purpose the being-for-itself of its freedom enters, exists as another essence, as a wisdom conscious of itself, which is outside that [process].
Observing reason therefore turns to this [wisdom], to spirit, to the concept existing as universality or the purpose existing as purpose; and its own essence is now the object for it.
zh: 因为概观迄今所考察的这一系列关系——它们构成观察的内容和对象——就表明：在它的第一种方式中，即在观察无机自然的关系时，感性存在对它来说就已经消失，它的关系的各个环节表现为纯粹抽象和简单概念，这些概念本该牢牢系在物的定在上，而定在却失去了，以致环节表明自己是纯粹的运动和普遍的东西。
这个自由的、在自身中完成了的过程保留着一种对象性的含义，但它只作为一个一而出现；在无机物的过程中，这个一是并不存在的内在；但作为一而存在着，它就是有机的东西。
——这个一作为自为存在或否定的本质与普遍的东西相对立，从后者那里抽身，并自为地保持自由，以致概念——它只在绝对单一化的要素中才得到实现——在有机的存在中找不到它作为普遍的东西而在场的真正表达，反而始终是有机自然的一个外在，或者，这同一回事，是有机自然的一个内在。
——有机的过程只是自在地自由，而不是自为地自由；在目的中，它的自由的自为存在出现了，它作为另一个本质而存在，作为一种意识到自身的智慧而存在，而这智慧在那个过程之外。
所以观察的理性转向这个智慧，转向精神，转向作为普遍性而存在的概念，或者作为目的而存在的目的；而它自己的本质现在成了它的对象。

en: It turns first to its purity; but since it is an apprehending of the object moving in its differences as an existent, laws of thinking become for it, relations of something persisting to something persisting; but since the content of these laws is only moments, they run out into the one of self-consciousness.

– This new object, taken likewise as an existent, is the single, contingent self-consciousness; observation therefore stands within the meant spirit and within the contingent relation of conscious actuality to unconscious.

It in itself alone is the necessity of this relation; observation therefore presses closer upon its body and compares its willing and acting actuality with its actuality reflected into itself and contemplating, which is itself objective.

This outer, although a language of the individual that it has on itself, is at the same time, as a sign, something indifferent to the content it was supposed to designate, just as that which posits the sign for itself is indifferent to this [sign].
zh: 它首先转向精神的纯粹性；但由于它是在把在自身差别中运动着的对象当作存在者来把握，思维规律就为它而出现，即持存者与持存者的关系；可是既然这些规律的内容只是环节，它们就消散进自我意识的那个一之中。
——这个新的对象同样被当作存在者来把握，就是单个的、偶然的自我意识；所以观察就站在被意谓的精神之内，站在有意识的现实性与无意识的东西的偶然关系之内。
精神自在地只是这种关系的必然性；所以观察更加逼近它的身体，把它的意愿着的和行动着的现实性与它在自身中反思着的、观看着的现实性相比较，后者本身是对象性的。
这个外在，虽然是个体在自己身上拥有的一种语言，但作为符号同时是某种对它所应标示的内容无关紧要的东西，正如为自己设定符号的那个东西对这个符号也无关紧要一样。

en: From this changeable language, therefore, observation finally goes back to firm being and, according to its concept, declares that externality is the outer and immediate actuality of spirit, not as organ, nor as language and sign, but as dead thing.

What was sublated by the very first observation of inorganic nature, namely that the concept should be present as a thing, this last mode produces in such a way that it makes the actuality of spirit itself into a thing or, expressed conversely, gives to dead being the meaning of spirit.
– Observation has thereby come to state what our concept of it was, namely that the certainty of reason seeks itself as objective actuality.

– To be sure, one does not mean by this that the spirit that is represented by a skull is stated as a thing; no materialism, as it is called, is to lie in this thought, but rather the spirit is to be still something other than this bone; but "it is" means itself nothing other than: it is a thing.
If being as such, or being-a-thing, is predicated of spirit, then the true expression of this is that it is something like a bone.
It must therefore be regarded as most important that the true expression of this — that of spirit it is purely said: it is — has been found.

If otherwise of spirit it is said that it is, has a being, is a thing, a single actuality, then nothing is meant thereby that one could see or take in the hand, push, and so on, but such a thing is said; and what is said in truth expresses itself hereby thus, that the being of spirit is a bone.
zh: 所以，从这种变化不定的语言出发，观察最终回到固定的存在，并且按照自己的概念说出：外在性不是作为器官，也不是作为语言和符号，而是作为死物，才是精神的外在的、直接的现实性。
最初对无机的自然的观察所扬弃的东西，即概念应当作为物而现成存在，这最后一种方式却这样把它造了出来：它把精神自己的现实性弄成一个物，或者反过来说，赋予死存在以精神的意义。
——观察由此已经进到说出我们关于它的概念本来是什么：理性的确定性把自身当作对象性的现实性来寻求。
——当然，人们在这里大概并不是说，由头颅所表象的精神被说成是一个物；这个思想里不应当有人们所称的唯物论，相反，精神毋宁还应当是不同于这块骨头的某种东西；但“它是”本身的意思不外是：它是一个物。
如果存在本身、或者说物的存在被用来述说精神，那么这件事的真正的表达就是：它是某种像一块骨头一样的东西。
因此必须把这一点看作极其重要：对于纯粹说出精神“它是”这件事，真正的表达已经被找到了。
如果平常说精神是、有一种存在、是一个物、是一个单个的现实性，那么借此意谓的并不是人们能够看见、拿在手里、推一推等等的某种东西，可是说出的却是这样一种东西；而真正被说出的东西由此就表达为：精神的存在是一块骨头。

en: This result now has a double meaning: on the one hand its true [meaning], insofar as it is a complement of the result of the preceding movement of self-consciousness.
The unhappy self-consciousness externalized its independence and wrested its being-for-itself out into a thing.

It thereby returned from self-consciousness back into consciousness, that is, into the consciousness for which the object is a being, a thing; – but this, which is thing, is self-consciousness; it is therefore the unity of the I and of being, the category.
Since the object is thus determined for consciousness, it has reason.

Consciousness as well as self-consciousness is in itself properly reason; but only of the consciousness for which the object has determined itself as the category can it be said that it has reason; – but from this, the knowing of what reason is, is still distinguished.

– The category, which is the immediate unity of being and of what is its own, must run through both forms, and the observing consciousness is precisely the one for which it presents itself in the form of being.
In its result, consciousness states as proposition that of which it is the unconscious certainty, – the proposition that lies in the concept of reason.
It is the infinite judgment that the self is a thing, – a judgment that sublates itself.
– Through this result, then, there has definitely been added to the category this, that it is this self-sublating opposition.
The pure category, which is for consciousness in the form of being or of immediacy, is the still unmediated, merely present object, and consciousness a likewise unmediated comportment.
The moment of that infinite judgment is the transition of immediacy into mediation or negativity.

The present object is therefore determined as a negative one, but consciousness as self-consciousness over against it, or the category, which has run through the form of being in observing, is now posited in the form of being-for-itself; consciousness no longer wants to find itself immediately, but to bring itself forth through its own activity.
It is itself to itself the purpose of its doing, just as in observing it was only concerned with things.
zh: 这个结果现在有双重意义：一方面是它真正的意义，就它是前面自我意识运动的结果的补充而言。
苦恼的自我意识外化了自己的独立性，把自己的自为存在挣扎成了一个物。
它由此从自我意识回到了意识，也就是回到那样一种意识：对它来说对象是一个存在、一个物；——但这个作为物的东西就是自我意识；所以它就是自我与存在的统一，即范畴。
对象既然对意识如此被规定，意识就有了理性。
意识和自我意识自在地本来都是理性；但只有对那样一种意识，即对象在它那里已把自己规定为范畴的意识，才能说它有理性；——不过，知道理性是什么，与这一点还是有区别的。
——范畴是存在与自己的东西的直接统一，它必须经历两种形式，而观察的意识正是那样一种意识：范畴在它面前以存在的形式呈现出来。
在自己的结果里，意识把它无意识地确信的东西作为一个命题说出来，——即那个包含在理性的概念里的命题。
它就是那个无限的判断：自我是一个物，——一个自己扬弃自己的判断。
——所以，通过这个结果，明确地给范畴添上了这样一点：它是这个自己扬弃自己的对立。
纯粹范畴以存在或直接性的形式对意识存在，它就是那个还没有被中介的、仅仅现成的对象，而意识则是一种同样没有被中介的态度。
那个无限判断的环节，就是直接性向中介或否定性的过渡。
所以现成的对象被规定为一个否定的东西，而意识则被规定为面对它的自我意识；或者说，范畴在观察中经历了存在的形式，现在被设定在自为存在的形式里；意识不再想直接地发现自己，而是想通过自己的活动把自己产生出来。
它自己对它来说就是它行动的目的，正如在观察中它只关乎物一样。

en: The other meaning of the result is the one already considered, of concept-less observation.

This knows how to grasp and state itself only as: it ingenuously declares the bone, as it is found as a sensuous thing, which does not at the same time lose its objectivity for consciousness, to be the actuality of self-consciousness.

But it also has no clarity of consciousness about its saying this, and does not grasp its proposition in the determinacy of its subject and predicate and their relation, still less in the sense of the infinite, self-dissolving judgment and of the concept.

– Rather, out of a deeper-lying self-consciousness of spirit, which here appears as a natural honesty, it hides from itself the shamefulness of the concept-less naked thought of taking a bone for the actuality of self-consciousness, and glosses it over through thoughtlessness itself, by mixing in manifold relations of cause and effect, of sign, organ, and so on, which have no sense here, and by distinctions taken from them, in order to conceal the garishness of the proposition.
zh: 这个结果的另一重意义，就是已经考察过的那种无概念的观察的意义。
这种观察不知道自己还能怎样把握和说出自己，只能是不带成见地把骨头——就像它作为感性之物被发现的那样，并不同时失去自己对于意识的对象性——说成自我意识的现实性。
但它对于自己说出这一点也没有意识的清晰性，并没有在自己的主体和谓词的规定性以及二者的关系中去把握自己的命题，更不用说在无限的、自我消解的判断和概念的意义上去把握了。
——它毋宁是出于精神的一种更深处的自我意识——这种自我意识在这里表现为一种天生的老实——而对自己掩盖了那种无概念的赤裸思想的可耻：把一块骨头当作自我意识的现实性；并且它靠无思想性本身来粉饰这一点：把原因与结果、符号、器官等等各种各样在这里毫无意义的关联混进来，又靠从这些关联中取来的种种区分，来掩盖命题的刺眼之处。

en: Brain fibers and the like, considered as the being of spirit, are already something thought, merely hypothetical, – not present, not felt, not seen, not the true actuality; if they are present, if they are seen, they are dead objects and then no longer count as the being of spirit.
But the proper objectivity must be an immediate, sensuous one, so that spirit is posited in this as dead – for the bone is the dead [element] insofar as it is on the living itself – as actual.

– The concept of this representation is that reason is itself all thinghood, even the purely objective; but it is this in the concept, or only the concept is its truth, and the purer the concept itself is, the more foolish a representation it sinks down to, when its content is not as concept but as representation, – when the self-sublating judgment is not taken with the consciousness of this its infinity, but as a persisting proposition, and its subject and predicate each count for themselves, the self fixed as self, the thing as thing, and yet the one is supposed to be the other.
– Reason, essentially the concept, is immediately divided within itself into itself and its opposite, an opposition that is precisely therefore just as immediately sublated.

But presenting itself thus as itself and as its opposite, and held fast in the wholly single moment of this stepping-apart, it is grasped unreasonably; and the purer the moments of this are, the more garish is the appearance of this content, which either is only for consciousness or is uttered by it ingenuously alone.

– The depth that spirit drives out from within, but only into its representing consciousness, and lets it stand there, – and the ignorance of this consciousness as to what it is that it says, is the same combination of high and low which nature on the living being naively expresses in the combination of the organ of its highest perfection, the organ of generation, and the organ of pissing.
– The infinite judgment as infinite would be the consummation of self-comprehending life; but the consciousness of it that remains in representation comports itself as pissing.
zh: 脑纤维之类的东西，被看作精神的存在时，已经是一种被设想出来的、仅仅是假设的东西，——不是定在着的，不是被感觉到的、被看见的，不是真正的现实性；如果它们定在着，如果它们被看见，它们就是死的对象，这时就不再算作精神的存在了。
但真正的对象性必须是一种直接的、感性的对象性，以致精神在这种作为死东西的对象性中——因为骨头就是死的东西，就它是在活的东西本身上而言——被设定为现实的。

——这种表象的概念是：理性自己就是一切物性，也包括纯粹对象性的物性；但理性是在概念中才是这样，或者说，只有概念才是它的真理；而概念本身越是纯粹，当它的内容不是作为概念、而是作为表象而存在时，它就越是沉沦为一种更加荒唐的表象，——当那个自己扬弃自己的判断不是带着对它这种无限性的意识被看待，而是被看成一个持存的命题，并且它的主体和谓词各自单独有效，自我被固定为自我，物被固定为物，却应当一个是另一个的时候。
——理性本质上就是概念，它直接地就在自身中分裂为自身和它的对立面，而这个对立正因如此也就同样直接地被扬弃了。
但如果它这样把自己呈现为自身和它的对立面，并且被固定在这种分开的完全单个的环节里，那它就是被非理性地把握了；而这种分开的各个环节越是纯粹，这个内容的现象就越是刺眼，而这个内容要么只是对意识而言才存在，要么就是被它不带成见地单独说出来的。
——精神从内部深处推出的、但只推到它那表象着的意识里并让它停在那里的那种深度，——以及这种意识对自己所说的究竟是什么一无所知，就是同一种高与低的联结；自然在活的东西身上，就用它的最高完善性的器官即生殖器官和撒尿的器官的联结，天真地表达出这种联结。
——无限的判断，作为无限的判断，会是把握着自身的生命的完成；但那个停留在表象中、关于它的意识，其表现却像撒尿一样。
